svg.title: 北京 · 独立建筑・闭合贝塞尔轮廓
svg.desc: Program-assisted architectural reconstruction after inspection of layered China Cup PSD. Every building owns explicitly closed exterior geometry. Curves are cubic Beziers; genuine corners and planar lattice are straight. Interior construction strokes may remain open. No embedded raster.
